intro: Lesson 18: 1.7 The Prophet ﷺ as leader: establishing the Shari'ah in Madinah. Plan or write in each box.

parts.text: Point 1: he taught the rulings revealed in Madinah. Develop: e.g. fasting Ramadan (2:183) and the qiblah change (2:144). Point 2: he judged between people. Develop: 4:65 says believers must accept his judgement, which made his Sunnah law.
